notes: Primary source: official Barco spec sheet (assets.barco.com), "Last updated: 09 Jul 2024". Product line ships in 5 variants sharing one chassis: R9004677 (standard), R9004683 (dual output), R9004666 (audio), R9004668 (dual output + audio), R9004695 (Jr). Port list above reflects the base/standard chassis I/O; the ImagePRO-II Jr variant omits the HDMI and DisplayPort ports; the dual-output variant adds a second 3G-SDI in, a second 3G-SDI out, and the S3D sync DIN in/out; the audio module (DB-25) is only present on the two audio-equipped variants. DisplayPort is spec'd as version 1.1 by Barco, which is not one of the allowed DP grades (dp-1.2/1.4/2.0) — mapped to dp-1.2 as the closest/lowest defined rung; treat as approximate. DIN connector (S3D sync) has no exact match in the allowed connector enum — mapped to midi-din as closest available id; treat as approximate, it is not literally a MIDI connector. DB-25 audio connector likewise has no exact match — mapped to euroblock as a placeholder for "multi-pin audio breakout," with accepts:[trs-6.35] omitted from the real spec (real breakout is XLR3 analog + BNC AES3, not TRS); flagged so it is not taken literally. AC inlet connector type (IEC C13/C14 vs other) is inferred, not explicitly confirmed in the fetched text. Ethernet is rated 10/100 Mbps per spec sheet, i.e., eth-100m grade (100BASE only, not gigabit).

ports.name: DVI-I In
ports.note: Dual-link DVI-I, HDCP, up to 4K@30p; field-replaceable connector; loop-through provided

ports.name: VGA In
ports.note: HD-15 universal analog input; loop-through provided

ports.name: HDMI In
ports.note: 165 MHz max; HDCP; not present on ImagePRO-II Jr variant

ports.name: DisplayPort In
ports.note: Spec sheet lists DisplayPort 1.1, 300 MHz max, supports 4K@30p; closest defined grade is dp-1.2 since dp-1.1 is not in the scale. Not present on ImagePRO-II Jr variant

ports.name: 3G-SDI In
ports.note: 3G/HD/SD-SDI input via BNC; loop-through provided; second 3G-SDI input added with dual-output board option

ports.name: DVI-I Out
ports.note: Dual-link DVI-I, HDCP, up to 4K@30p; field-replaceable connector

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: 165 MHz max; HDCP; not present on ImagePRO-II Jr variant

ports.name: DisplayPort Out
ports.note: Spec sheet lists DisplayPort 1.1, 300 MHz max, supports 4K@30p; closest defined grade is dp-1.2. Not present on ImagePRO-II Jr variant

ports.name: 3G-SDI Out
ports.note: Second 3G-SDI output added with dual-output board option

ports.name: Genlock Ref In/Loop
ports.note: Analog reference input/loop; bi-level and blackburst at SD, tri-level at HD, or locked to any input signal

ports.name: S3D Sync In
ports.note: Stereoscopic 3D sync input, DIN connector; closest listed connector id is midi-din (generic DIN not in enum); dual-output board option only

ports.name: S3D Sync Out
ports.note: Stereoscopic 3D sync output, DIN connector; closest listed connector id is midi-din (generic DIN not in enum); dual-output board option only

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: 10/100 Mbps autosense; used for web browser / tablet / smartphone control (Etherconn-style rugged RJ45 per marketing copy)

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Front-panel USB port for configuration backup/restore via flash drive; speed/grade not stated in spec sheet

ports.name: Audio I/O (DB-25)
ports.note: Optional Audio Module (R9004666 / R9004668 variants only). Physical connector on the mezzanine board is a DB-25 (not in the connector enum; mapped here to closest available id). Breaks out via Barco audio breakout cable to 2x analog stereo in + 2x analog stereo out on XLR, and 8 AES3 digital in + 8 AES3 digital out on BNC (75 ohm unbalanced).

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: 100-240 VAC 50/60Hz, 2A max. Exact IEC inlet variant (C13/C14) not explicitly stated in spec sheet; inferred from standard 1RU rack-power practice for this product class.
